metadata.description: A public research release and deployable toolkit for studying humor structure without treating model surprisal as funniness. Includes rights-filtered data, executable Kaggle studies, deterministic CC0 controls, adversarial and multimodal contracts, human-study launch tooling, provider-neutral integrations, an API, and deployment manifests.
metadata.title: Humor Genome Wave 2: reproducible humor-structure research and integration toolkit
